scope.note: counts, not a guarantee: `native_sees` is the file set checkstyle was invoked on; `limen_rule_scopes_cover` is the subset matched by at least one emitted rule scope. `native_only_files` are files the native tool checked that no limen rule scopes (their packages had no denied target, so no rule was emitted for them) and `limen_only_files` are files a rule scope matches outside the invoked roots. Both are potential sources of one-sided findings.
